title: 7S.3 single-frame custom-class OBJECT rollback
mode: Generated local implementation slice and focused fast validation
scope: Avoid document-wide class-ledger copies when a fixed-frame OBJECT is associated with one explicitly registered class instance.
Restore the exact per-handle class-instance state when a committed frame lacks a valid receipt.
Move the one-frame DBCOLOR facade callback onto the fixed-frame transaction route.

implementation.behavior: Added a compact DwgClassInstanceCheckpoint for one associated handle. The fixed-object transaction captures the registered class number, pending/emitted membership, and class emission count; on receipt or frame failure it rolls back the byte/object-map suffix and restores only that class-instance entry. DBCOLOR now uses the helper. Compound operations and inconsistent class associations retain comprehensive fallback behavior.
generatedControls: A registered DBCOLOR frame is emitted, then its frame receipt is deliberately withheld; frame/object-map state and all four class-instance ledgers return to the pre-write state with zero full checkpoints.
The same registered DBCOLOR retries successfully with zero full checkpoints, one object frame, one emitted class-instance handle, and one corresponding emission-count increment.
A reserved-handle DICTIONARY refusal preserves the pre-existing class association without taking a full checkpoint.

limitations: The targeted rollback is synchronous and scoped to a single immediately following frame; it is not a replacement for the complete checkpoint on compound operations.
